items.title: Bobby Militello interviewed by Monk Rowe, Buffalo, New York, October 14, 2002
items.q: Chick Corea’s Electric Band is a wonderful experience to listen to. I love it.

ctx.x: It’s wonderful, oh yeah. Those people who think that jazz is still in its demise and whatever, well I mean it’s always been the small demo. It’s always been that three percent of the record buying market and of that the three percent, they include fusion and Rock and funk and everything else into that three percent. So take even a smaller percentage of that for really aesthetically correct — or whatever — jazz, you know the real jazz. Nothing wrong with fusion stuff especially played well. Chick Corea’s Electric…
Has it become more of an art music? I’m not sure I’m saying that right but it’s been culturally certainly elevated and it’s in all the schools now and you know you can go to universities and stuff.
